title: Core: AS2 unary operators (!, ~, -, +, typeof, void)
description: Test compilation of unary operators: !x (ActionNot 0x14), ~x (bitwise NOT, compiled as x^-1 using ActionBitXor 0x62), -x (ActionNegate 0x4E or ActionSubtract), +x (no-op or ActionToNumber), typeof x (ActionTypeOf 0x44), void 0 (discard value), void fn() (ActionPop). Verify each emits the expected opcode.
